retrievalProfile.description: A candid, side-profile male portrait against a neutral brick wall with right-aligned slab-serif typography.
triggerTerms: candid male portrait against brick wall
slab serif typography with horizontal rule
excludeWhen: abstract or minimalist art is needed
sans-serif or script typography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a smiling man in profile, seated against a light-colored brick wall. The lighting is soft and directional, coming from the left. The right side of the frame features stacked, right-aligned slab-serif text with a thin horizontal line separating the primary and secondary lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject looking away from the camera toward the light source
Text positioned in the negative space to the right of the subject's head
Color harmony between the blue shirt and the cool-toned shadows of the white brick
Horizontal rule separating the artist name from the album title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, seated and angled toward the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the left, then moves to the right to read the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant provides a clean, textured area for typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and light gray (brick wall background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high key values; the image feels bright and airy.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with wide proportions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two sizes, separated by a graphic line.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule between text lines

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight and wide proportions.
Provides a similar slab-serif feel with slightly more modern geometry.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man with dark hair and a denim shirt, smiling in profile against a light-colored brick wall. Ensure soft lighting from the left and ample negative space on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, uppercase slab-serif text in white in the upper right corner. Place a thin horizontal line between the two lines of text.

verificationChecks: Is the font a heavy slab-serif?
Is there a horizontal line between the text lines?
Is the subject in profile looking toward the light?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the artist

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's head.
Ensure the brick texture is visible but not distracting.
Verify the slab-serif font maintains a bold, masculine feel.
Confirm the horizontal rule is centered vertically between the text lines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Candid profile portrait + neutral textured background + right-aligned slab-serif typography.
